classification: historical evidence reconciliation; not new experimental results

reports.title: Mathematical and timing/threshold audit
reports.scope: Source-backed utility-scale, long-launch, coupled spatial gates and timer concerns; no production repair.
reports.limitations: Current generators/executors changed later; long-pass mismatch must be remeasured, not assumed fixed or still identical.

reports.title: Shared state-value decision reform
reports.scope: Common next-state branches, readiness, prospective corridors, finite movement authority and paired studies.
reports.limitations: Normalised branches and shared utility remain uncalibrated; selected actions are biased samples.

reports.title: Contact lifecycle and policy validation
reports.scope: Physical contact/rebound lifecycle and demonstrated aerial-continuity corrections; preserved old source.
reports.limitations: Deterministic collision correctness does not establish body geometry or restitution calibration.

reports.title: Role-driven intelligence
reports.scope: Role variants reuse shared generator/value while differing in organisation and intentions.
reports.limitations: They are not independent cognitive models; role effects need physical consequence and match transfer evidence.

reports.title: Tempo and ball interaction
reports.scope: Incoming action/first-touch execution and shared contact work; observed circulation issues retained.
reports.limitations: First-time labels and low-level fixes do not close full-match tempo or selection.

reports.title: Depth/wing/aerial football
reports.scope: Research expanded attacking depth, wing duels and aerial/set-piece opportunities.
reports.limitations: Eligibility/physical participation differ from calibrated duel, goalkeeper and outcome quality.

reports.title: Tactical/policy validation
reports.scope: Policy comparison and fixture audit provide development failure/behaviour context.
reports.limitations: Changing a tactical role or passing a fixture does not certify attacking utility.

reports.title: Realism stabilisation
reports.scope: Full-match negative research and closure/retreat auditing retain policy-specific pathologies.
reports.limitations: Rejected designs and development outcomes remain negative evidence, not a general realism promotion.

reports.title: Canonical performance lab
reports.scope: Shared canonical movement/contact/flight; 28-attribute source inventory; physical apparatus checks.
reports.limitations: Goal/target success proves geometry completion, not real football rates. A fixed planning receiver is an explicit apparatus assumption.

reports.title: Extended physical testing
reports.scope: Finite foot surfaces/spin, plant balance, two-contact moves, keeper releases and work/recovery trials.
reports.limitations: Specialised strong kicks/shot resolvers remain; contact parameters are not physiological calibration.

reports.title: Cognition and attribute diagnostics
reports.scope: Shared-policy audit, directed heading/composure/timing sensitivity and bounded cognition prototypes.
reports.limitations: Found same B scoring expectation across distinct shot techniques; sensitivity is not calibration, canonical captain delivery remains absent.

reports.title: Bounded on-ball O/H/J policies
reports.scope: Whitelisted scenes, separate bounded mechanisms, explicit future-independent research protocol.
reports.limitations: Defence/orientation/GK/restarts remain partly full-world. Independent confirmation sealed.

reports.title: Relative decisions and stabilisation
reports.scope: Prices waiting and distinguishes preparation from release; legal kickoff and quick/prepared human free kicks.
reports.limitations: Full WW liveness falsified local fixes; old fields and fixtures are development, not fresh confirmation.

reports.title: Contact/duel geometry and deadlocks
reports.scope: Physical exposed-contact and restart/deadlock repairs, rejected cycles preserved.
reports.limitations: A repaired liveness failure does not calibrate defensive reach or passive contact dominance.

reports.title: Passing, effective time, articulated-contact foundation
reports.scope: Replaces absolute reception-quality failure with finite cushioning execution; correct full dead-ball measurement.
reports.limitations: Forecast still maps reception quality through numerical retention cutoffs; helper predictions need revalidation.

reports.title: First touch and one-touch lab
reports.scope: Finite foot/thigh/chest experiments, real contact witnesses, repeat/mutating-observer checks; opt-in body contacts.
reports.limitations: Volleys/headers remain limited; full airborne finishing/keeper gaps/rotation/landing are not implemented.

reports.title: Observed ball recovery and natural flow
reports.scope: Opt-in next-contact movement and finite throw-in lifting; original failures reconstructed.
reports.limitations: Better recovery increased active time. Natural boundary/restart/attacking distributions remain open; integration timeout investigation retained.

reports.title: Transitions, clearances, opportunity windows
reports.scope: Opt-in temporal passes/third man/finite clearance/scoring experiments; 15 paired development matches.
reports.limitations: Passes24373→22546 and shots214→183; pooled changes conceal major policy regressions. No global quality claim.

reports.title: Active perception, preparation, receiving positions, tempo
reports.scope: 73 lab conditions, 40 receiving phases, 27 complete final matches; observed bounded pass ray and protected structural movement regressions.
reports.limitations: Combined attempts22546→18220, shots183→195 conceal WW/B22→14, WW/R3 25→11 and WW/H0. Three matching prepared releases do not prove universal preparation benefit.
